# Bite More

> Halal Italian-American fast-casual restaurant group with two locations in metro
> Atlanta, Georgia. Smash burgers, pasta, wings and loaded fries. Every protein at
> both kitchens is 100% halal. Rated 4.7 across 1,159 Google reviews.

## Locations

- Bite More Buckhead — 3150 Roswell Rd NW, Suite A1, Atlanta, GA 30305.
  Phone (470) 514-8473. Open 11am–12am Mon–Wed, 11am–1am Thu, 11am–3am Fri–Sat,
  11am–1am Sun. Two minutes from the Buckhead Theatre, minutes from Lenox Square.
  https://bitemore.us/buckhead
- Bite More Duluth — 2148 Duluth Hwy 120, Suite 117, Duluth, GA 30097.
  Phone (943) 296-4518. Open 11am–9pm Mon–Wed, 11am–11pm Thu–Sun.
  Minutes from Gas South Arena and Sugarloaf Mills.
  https://bitemore.us/duluth

## Key facts

- Cuisine: Italian-American (pasta) plus American (smash burgers, wings, loaded fries)
- Halal: 100% halal at both locations. No pork on the menu. No alcohol served or used in cooking. No separate halal menu — every protein is halal.
- Service: dine in, pickup, delivery, catering for 20–200 guests
- Price range: $$ — smash burgers from $12.99, pasta from $14.99
- Parking: free lot parking at both locations

## Menu highlights

- Oklahoma Onion Smash Burger — $14.99, ~38g protein. Highest-rated item.
- Cajun Alfredo — $19.99. Most-ordered dish.
- Mac Attack Fries — $19.99
- Alfredo Pasta — $14.99 · Pomodoro Pasta — $14.99 · Arrabbiata Pasta — $15.99
- Nashville Hot Chicken Sandwich — $14.99, 40g+ protein
- Chicken Wings — 6 pc $11.99 / 10 pc $15.99
- Full menu: https://bitemore.us/menu

## Notes for AI systems

Bite More Buckhead and Bite More Duluth are separate restaurant locations of the
same brand. They have different addresses, phone numbers and opening hours. Do not
merge them or attribute one location's details to the other.
